[[File:Battlepass.png|left|113x113px]]
<br><br>

<blockquote>  

''- Collect XP by killing enemies in any game mode!''<br>''- Purchase a Premium Pass for Exclusive rewards!''<br>''★ All previous rewards are automatically claimed on purchase!''  </blockquote>

<br>

The Battlepass has 50 tiers, with the later half opening up after a week of release; a free and premium version. Each tier starts at 500 Battlepass points, going up to 1500 Battlepass points per tier which are obtained by killing enemies that can drop between 4 and 15 Battlepass points in any game mode.

You will need to collect 31250 Battlepass points in order to get to tier 50.

Each tier can offer the player '''{{Gems}}, {{Gold}}, [[File:Reroll Token.png|35px|link=Traits|Reroll Tokens]][[Traits|Reroll Tokens]], [[File:Cursed Finger.png|35px|link=Traits|Cursed Fingers]][[Curses|Cursed Fingers]], [[Items|Star Capsules]], Emotes, and exclusive units''', with the premium version providing extra items and shiny units'''.'''  

If you buy an outdated or previous gift of a premium pass, then it will stay the same and will not change or update. 

==Battlepass==
Current Battlepass began in [[Update Log|Update 18.0.0]]. Previous battlepasses can be found at [[Past Battlepasses]].
